name: meeting-action-items
description: Paste meeting notes via form, extract structured action items with an LLM step, then format the list — showcasing OpenSOP's reliability story for agentic extraction.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Full meeting notes to extract action items from

steps.description: Extract action items with owner and task from the meeting notes.
Format the action item list as a Markdown checklist.
steps.run:
jq -r '
  "## Action Items — " + (.inputs.meeting_title // "Meeting") + "\n" +
  (if (."extract-actions".items | length) == 0 then
    "_No action items found._"
  else
    [ ."extract-actions".items[] | "- [ ] **" + .owner + ":** " + .task ] | join("\n")
  end)
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{action_items: .}'
